CustomField.description: Number of articles to process per Queueable execution. Balances throughput vs the 10-minute Apex async transaction limit. Each LLM-using dimension adds ~5s/article, so larger batches risk transaction timeouts on hybrid scoring.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Articles processed per async batch. Recommended range: 5-25 for hybrid scoring (LLM enabled), 25-100 for deterministic-only. Default: 10.
CustomField.label: Queueable Batch Size
